plugins.name: visual-audit
plugins.description: Audit a running interface for visual quality against a default-tier rubric, then rank findings by visual impact.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Verify a feature works and is good to use by driving it in a real browser across fifteen instruments.

plugins.name: place-audit
plugins.description: Audit where information sits on a page versus where the user's declared tasks need it — per-atom demand vs prominence, redundancy detection, and ranked relocation flags.

plugins.name: content-audit
plugins.description: Audit what information deserves to exist and when: semantic duplication, view overlap, content priority, role separation, and progressive disclosure before placement/design.
